messages:

Subject: MSA redline: audit-rights zipper plan, staging access cutover & evidence handback

Hi Asha — attaching our latest MSA redline (v3) and a first-pass pen-test SOW.

Key ask up-front: we want to propose a lightweight "zipper" for audit/evidence handbacks so we can align legal redlines with operational reality. High level:
- Pen-test window: prefer a single 2-week window with a short ramp (see SOW) rather than open-ended rolling access.
- Staging access: ephemeral staging creds behind MFA; no persistent privileged accounts.
- Evidence cadence: weekly bundled evidence packages (CSV index + pre-signed S3 links) + final consolidation within 7 days of test close.

Questions for your legal/procurement team:
1) Will Helix accept an order-form-level carve that limits inspection to a staging environment + scoped production hooks (telemetry only)?
2) Are SOC 2 reports from the last 12 months sufficient for initial approval, or do you need control-level mapping?
3) Any vendor-procurement constraints on pen-test researchers (whitepaper vs. named vendor list)?

Attachments: Redwood_MSA_redline_v3.docx (redlines inline), PenTest_Scope_SOW_v2.pdf (ops scoping).

Next steps: if you sign off on zipper cadence, we can convert the redline into a tracked-orderform change and produce the evidence-index template for Helix security to validate.

Thanks — Jonas
Jonas Weber
Head of Compliance Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Jonas — thanks for the quick turn. A few quick notes from procurement/legal: 

- Legal wants more explicit language on "ephemeral access" — specifically, a short-lived credential lifetime and audit logging that is retained for 90 days.
- Our security team (cc'd) prefers that pen-tests occur in a non-production environment unless a production test is absolutely required and approved through our change-board.
- On SOC 2: initial packet should include the full report + TSC scope summary. A control mapping (we provide a template) will be needed before go/no-go.

Can you confirm whether Redwood can provide:
- A short control mapping CSV (Redwood control ID -> SOC 2 section)
- Proof that staging can be provisioned with MFA and ephemeral creds (screenshots or a runbook stub)?

I'll loop in our security vendor (Kai) to discuss the pen-test scoping and provide preferred researcher requirements.

Regards,
Asha Patel
Senior Procurement Manager
Helix Health

Subject: Re: MSA redline: audit-rights zipper plan, staging access cutover & evidence handback

Asha — great, thanks. Answers below and a proposal for the zipper handback cadence.

Quoted: "Can you confirm whether Redwood can provide a short control mapping CSV..."
- Yes. We'll provide a one-page control map CSV that maps our SOC 2 attestations to the typical Helix control references. Will attach as evidence-index.csv in the next message.

Quoted: "Proof that staging can be provisioned with MFA and ephemeral creds"
- Confirmed. Staging access can be time-boxed (default 72-hour creds) and issued via an internal ephemeral token system; we will provide a runbook excerpt and a screenshot of the session issuance UI.

Proposed zipper cadence (operational, to be encoded in the order form annex):
- Day 0 (test start): kickoff call; test plan and authorized researcher list exchanged.
- Weekly: evidence bundle (CSV index + pre-signed S3 links) shared with Helix security; bundles are redacted for PII.
- Day +2 after test close: preliminary findings (ops-facing, non-PHI) delivered to Helix security.
- Day +7: full evidence handback + final report delivery.

Pen-test window proposal: Oct 11–24, 2026 (2-week window + 2-day buffer for administrative wrap). If Helix prefers non-prod only, we'll scope to staging and provide telemetry-only production hooks as needed.

Attachments in next email: evidence-index.csv (control map + placeholder rows).

I'll assign Karthik to prepare updated legal counters that capture the zipper cadence, ephemeral access language, and evidence retention clause. Vanessa — can you prepare the runbook excerpt and session screenshot for Helix?

Thanks — Jonas

From: Kai Morgan <auditor@pegasus-audit.com>
To: Asha Patel <procurement@helixhealth.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 04 Aug 2026 09:18:00 +01:00
Subject: Re: MSA redline: audit-rights zipper plan, staging access cutover & evidence handback

Thanks for the thread — Kai from Pegasus (external assessor). A few technical clarifications from my side: 

1) Scoping: we need to confirm whether the test will be limited to staging or if parts of production telemetry (read-only) will be included. If production telemetry is allowed, we need a written brief of what endpoints are in-scope and confirmation that no production PII will be exposed.

2) Privileged access: for deeper testing we sometimes request break-glass SSH or elevated API keys for scoped windows. Will Redwood accept break-glass with time-limited justification and full session recording?

3) Evidence retention: we typically request 12 months of raw session logs for auditability. Is 90 days the maximum Redwood can retain by default, or can you support a 12-month retention request per-customer?

4) Deliverables: sample deliverables we expect are (a) control mapping CSV, (b) test-plan with endpoints and allowed techniques, (c) raw session log archive (encrypted), (d) final report.

If you can confirm answers to 1–3 we can finalize our scheduling and pre-qualification of the tester team.

Best — Kai Morgan
Principal Security Assessor
Pegasus Audit Labs

Attachment referenced: Pegasus-vendor-policy.pdf (requested researcher vetting checklist)

Subject: INTERNAL: Helix orderform — next steps, legal asks, and action owners (zipper plan)

Team — summarizing Helix thread and what I need from legal/ops to move this to a final order form: 

Summary: Helix procurement is open to the zipper approach but requires: explicit ephemeral-cred language, SOC 2 report + control mapping, and confirmation that pen-tests will be non-production by default. Pegasus (auditor) asked about break-glass privileges and retention windows.

Action items: 
- Karthik: prepare a short legal counter that encodes: (a) ephemeral creds with TTL <= 72 hours, (b) audit log retention at customer request (default 90d, escalate to 12 months with commercial approval), (c) a staging-only clause with an explicit production-exception flow requiring change-board approval. Target draft: EOD Thu 2026-08-05.
- Vanessa: compile runbook excerpt + session issuance screenshot and a templated evidence-index.csv. Put artifacts in the shared Drive link and notify Asha.
- Laura: coordinate pricing/billing carve for extended retention (12 months) and prepare an amendment rate sheet for Helix procurement.

Operational notes to preserve in the orderform annex: proof-of-evidence will be delivered as weekly zipped bundles (no raw PII), pre-signed S3 links with 7-day expiry, and an ops-only preliminary findings deliverable at +2 days. Final report at +7.

I'll wait for Karthik's legal counters before sending a redline back to Helix. We should avoid broad "inspection" language in the MSA; instead we put a scoped audit annex that references the zipper cadence and the pen-test SOW.

Thanks — Jonas
